cost_components.decoder: 1024 deterministic in-bounds words per execution, whole-word multiply/correction versus lane-wise reference; dynamic scale/bias/lane inputs and observable checksum.
cost_components.matched_baseline: Same native walk/state/evidence storage; all pair branches rather than distinct product branches. Both arms precompute products.
cost_components.native_walk: Full frontier traversal including ordered map operations, allocation, complete retained layers/edges, and full least-prefix copying. Not pure arithmetic instruction latency.
cost_components.preparation: Separate phase samples; reported preparation-plus-walk ratio sums paired phase times, not a timed fused end-to-end path. Serialization and Python checking excluded.
cost_components.python_checker: Delivered independent checker not included in native walk; separately measured only after slot permission, with its own continuing private charge record.
cost_components.serialization: Separate optimized full-certificate JSON serialization samples on a frozen graph, including stream allocation; no disk I/O in timed region.

host.affinity: Native process pinned before any warmup or timing to lowest currently allowed logical CPU; actual one-bit mask queried and verified. Correctness preparations pinned to CPU 0, mask 0x1, original allowed mask 0xfffff. Python replay pinned to same selected CPU.
host.clock_power_thermal_controls: Not modified; no controlled-frequency or cross-host claim

implementation: C++17 compiled by coordinator-provided Zig 0.15.2/Clang for x86_64-windows-gnu, -O3 -DNDEBUG

limits.allowed_claim: Local CPU-native execution and performance only
limits.scientific_scope: Reviewed benign local synthetic workloads only

paired_design.anti_elimination: Compiler memory barrier before each execution; volatile checksum after each execution; externally named noinline arithmetic functions.
paired_design.order: UQ on even pair numbers, QU on odd pair numbers; RP/PR for decoder. Preparation follows the same alternating order.
paired_design.slower_cases: Retain and report every case with median paired ratio below one.
paired_design.statistic: Median of per-pair baseline/optimized elapsed-time ratios; raw samples plus min/max retained for every case. No significance or population-generalization claim.

panel.controls: Eight signed-width/initialization controls, six unique/duplicate product controls at 4/8/16 stages, one no-observation control. Not part of original result aggregates.
panel.selection: No outcome-dependent filtering. All accumulator cases included; decoder timing conditional only on pre-existing exact safe verdict.
